raw.title: Our Time's passed, John
raw.description:
I got a plan John. This is a good one.
We can't always pwn nature, John.
We can't pwn calloc.
We can't pwn safe linking without a heap leak.
We can't pwn nothing.

My whole life, all I ever did was pwn. But I can't give up, neither. I can't fight my own nature.
That's a paradox, John.

You see? When I'm gone, they'll just spin up a clanker.
They have to, because they have to justify their GPU spend.

Our time has passed, John.
Good luck.
